question: You switch from Alice to Bob quickly. Alice’s request is slower. What can go wrong?
options: Nothing: React cancels the old fetch
Bob’s page can end up showing Alice’s bio
The Effect runs in an infinite loop
say: You switch from Alice to Bob quickly. Alice’s request is slower. What can go wrong?
explanation: Nothing stops the old request. If Alice’s answer arrives last, setBio shows her bio on Bob’s page. An ignore flag set in cleanup fixes it.
explainSay: Bob’s page can show Alice’s bio. The late answer still sets state, unless cleanup tells it to ignore.
